summary: The frozen cleanup claim does not require a harness update. When destruction occurs with a pending last_comment, the after destructor releases it. The harness’s early return on parse error prevents destruction, which is a separate condition.

claims.necessity_reason: The claimed consequence is refuted on the after side: ucl_parser_free unrefs last_comment whenever destruction occurs with that field set. A skipped call to ucl_parser_free does not satisfy the frozen condition.

before.requirement: Release a saved, unattached last_comment during parser destruction.
before.reason: The fixed harness creates the parser with flags 0. The supplied comment-saving path requires UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS; the before destructor has no last_comment release.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The shown comment-saving call is guarded by UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
Parser creation retains the supplied flags and initializes comment storage only when the save-comments flag is set.

after.requirement: Release a saved, unattached last_comment during parser destruction.
after.reason: The fixed parser setup does not enable the shown comment-saving path. Even if destruction occurs with last_comment set, the after destructor releases it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The shown comment-saving call is guarded by UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
Parser creation retains the supplied flags and initializes comment storage only when the save-comments flag is set.

claims.comparison_reason: The before destructor lacks the release; the after destructor performs it whenever the frozen destruction condition holds. The harness’s error return concerns whether destruction occurs, so it is a different obligation.
